tools.name: desktop_control
tools.description: Control the streamed assistant desktop. scope=browser uses its exact Chrome/profile with semantic refs and compact page state; scope=desktop (default) uses screenshots and X11. Browser: start with tabs, then observe a target_id; use the latest observation_id and ref for click/type/key. type appends text to that field. Browser navigation accepts HTTP(S); new_tab, close_tab, scroll and wait require the latest observation. Browser actions do not return images. Use desktop scope for browser chrome, canvas or inaccessible frames. Call done when finished. Never targets a personal host browser.

observation_id.description: Latest observation_id. Required for input actions.

key.description: Desktop: X11 key combination. Browser: Enter, Tab, Escape, arrows, Backspace, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown or Space.

amount.description: Desktop: 1-20 wheel steps. Browser: 1-5 increments of 600 pixels, up or down.

target_id.description: Exact browser tab identifier from tabs. observe activates and foregrounds this tab.

frame_id.description: Optional frame ID from browser state. Omit to retain selected frame; use the main frame ID for navigation and clicks.

ref.description: Exact element eid from the latest browser observation, required for click/type/key.
